title: HubSpot Marketing Hub vs ActiveCampaign: Testing the Best AI Marketing Tools for Ecommerce - Ecommerce-Platforms.com

facts.fact: The page's author says the article was updated on April 13, 2026.
The page's comparison table lists HubSpot's integration ecosystem as 2,000 apps (vendor-level count as stated by the author).
facts.quote: 2,000 apps; deep two-way data sync (Shopify, Slack, Stripe etc.)

facts.fact: The page's comparison table lists ActiveCampaign's integration ecosystem as 1,000 apps.
facts.quote: 1,000 apps; good email integrations, heavier reliance on Zapier

facts.fact: The page's comparison table states ActiveCampaign's built-in CRM includes unlimited pipelines on all plans.
facts.quote: Built-in CRM with unlimited pipelines on all plans

facts.fact: The page's comparison table states HubSpot's pipelines are capped by plan, while ActiveCampaign offers unlimited pipelines on all plans.
facts.quote: Native Smart CRM; pipelines capped by plan

facts.fact: The page's comparison table states ActiveCampaign offers free 1:1 migration on the Pro plan and above.
facts.quote: Free 1:1 migration (Pro +), good support for email teams

facts.fact: The page's comparison table states HubSpot offers a free CRM with tiered hubs priced by users and features.
The page's comparison table describes ActiveCampaign pricing as contact-based, with a cheaper start that scales quickly.
facts.quote: Contact-based pricing; cheaper start but scales fast

facts.fact: The page's comparison table states ActiveCampaign provides native support for 75 languages.
The page's comparison table states ActiveCampaign offers native email, SMS, WhatsApp, and transactional email messaging.
facts.quote: Native email + SMS + WhatsApp + transactional email

facts.fact: The page's comparison table states HubSpot offers SMS messaging only via integration.
The page's comparison table states HubSpot's AI tools include Breeze AI Agents for Content, Social, and Prospecting, plus AI CPQ and Data Hub Intelligence.
facts.quote: Breeze AI Agents (Content, Social, Prospecting), AI CPQ, Data Hub Intelligence

facts.fact: The page's comparison table states ActiveCampaign's AI tools include Predictive Sending, Content Optimization, and Active Intelligence agents.
facts.quote: Predictive Sending, Content Optimization, Active Intelligence agents

facts.fact: The author states that in their testing, a user can set up conditions and start running personalized automations in ActiveCampaign in less than an hour (author's own claim, not verified).
facts.quote: drop in conditions, and start firing personalized automations in less than an hour

facts.fact: The page's comparison table states HubSpot offers guided onboarding with a free CRM ready in minutes.
facts.quote: Guided onboarding, free CRM ready in minutes, unified workspace

facts.fact: The page discloses that Reeves and Sons Limited may earn a commission if readers subscribe to a service through links on the page.
facts.quote: If you subscribe to a service from a link on this page, Reeves and Sons Limited may earn a commission.

facts.fact: The page's comparison table lists HubSpot's reporting as including multi-touch attribution, custom dashboards, and Data Hub warehouse integration.
facts.quote: Multi-touch attribution, custom dashboards, Data Hub warehouse integration

facts.fact: The page's comparison table describes ActiveCampaign's reporting as campaign-level analytics with a limited cross-channel view.
facts.quote: Campaign-level analytics; excellent for email flows, limited cross-channel view

facts.fact: The page's comparison table states HubSpot provides web content translation via DeepL.
